content.comment_body: Hello, A few years ago I bought version [version_no] of [product_name] and used it on Windows. I recently purchased a logic module ([article_no]) and need to update my software version. Now I am using macOS Catalina and need guidance on how to proceed, as macOS doesn't open the CD version. I downloaded the demo of [product_name] [version_no]. I am a university professor and use this equipment and software in my courses.

I don't use macOS, but I have seen on forums that many encounter issues installing [product_name] on macOS. [company_name] has not tested it with your operating system. Please refer to the attachment for operating systems officially tested and supported by [company_name].

From what I remember, you need to download the upgrade of [product_name] using a Windows PC. If you try on a Mac, installation might not work. You can search the [product_name] forum for guidance specific to Catalina. However, [user_name] is correct — Catalina hasn't been tested by [company_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing notable compatibility issues when trying to use [product_name] software on macOS Catalina. The main issue involves upgrading from an older Windows-based version, needing to use newer hardware, but hitting obstacles due to limited macOS support and installation problems. Community members emphasize that [company_name] has not officially tested or supported macOS Catalina for this software, which adds uncertainty and restricts seamless cross-platform operation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates upgrading and running [product_name] on macOS Catalina without difficulties so that they can continue using their hardware for educational and development activities.
